title: Fix PetOverlay follow behavior and ensure only a single pet is shown (overlay + app icon)

requirements.text: Fix the PetOverlay so the pet visually follows the user during an active session (the overlay position should track the user’s pointer/movement within the page rather than feeling ‘stuck’ in one corner). Maintain non-blocking behavior (do not interfere with page interactions) and keep the overlay fully on-screen.

quotes: the pet is not following the user. fix it.

acceptanceCriteria: During an active focus/break session, the pet overlay repositions in response to pointer movement (smoothly, without jitter).
The overlay never blocks clicks/typing in underlying UI except for its own controls (e.g., mute button remains clickable).
The overlay clamps to the viewport so it cannot drift off-screen.

requirements.text: Fix sprite rendering in PetOverlay so only one pet frame is visible at a time (do not show the entire sprite sheet). Ensure the speech bubble and mute icon remain correctly positioned relative to the single visible pet frame.

quotes: also make the icon show only one of the pet.

acceptanceCriteria: The PetOverlay displays exactly one 128x128 sprite frame (no adjacent frames from the sprite sheet are visible).
Changing mood/phase swaps the visible frame correctly without resizing or showing multiple pets.
The layout matches the intent shown in the uploaded screenshot (single pet body with bubble above; no multi-frame strip visible).

requirements.text: Update the app’s favicon/app icon so it displays a single pet (not multiple pets/frames). Use a pixel-art single-pet icon and ensure it is used by the browser tab (and any manifest/PWA icon configuration present in the project).

quotes: also make the icon show only one of the pet.

acceptanceCriteria: Browser tab icon renders as a single pet icon (not a sprite strip / multiple pets).
If a web manifest is present/used by the build, it references the new single-pet icon asset(s) and no longer points to sprite sheets.
No console errors related to missing icon assets.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain single-actor; no backend changes are required for these fixes.
nonGoals: Adding new pet types beyond cat/dog.
Changing mood/dialogue logic or session timing logic beyond what is necessary to keep the overlay functional.

required: Pixel-art app icon depicting a single pet (cat) centered on a transparent or solid background (app-icon-cat.dim_512x512.png)
Pixel-art app icon depicting a single pet (dog) centered on a transparent or solid background (app-icon-dog.dim_512x512.png)
Pixel-art favicon depicting a single pet (cat) simplified for small sizes (favicon-cat.dim_64x64.png)
Pixel-art favicon depicting a single pet (dog) simplified for small sizes (favicon-dog.dim_64x64.png)
